question: Through which of the following cities does Mithi river pass?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Mumbai.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **Salsette Island, an island in the Indian city **of Mumbai, there is a river called the **Mithi River**.
 
• It is the meeting point of the Powai and **Vihar lakes' tailwater discharges.**
 
• The** river rises during the monsoons** and is a seasonal feature. The river flow, which is** occasionally halted by a dam**, is also influenced by the **overflowing lakes.**
 
• **Mumbai's thriving cotton textile factories** have garnered the nickname** "Cottonopolis of India"** for the city.
 
• **The mills used the river's water** over the years and discharged their garbage there, which resulted in the **river's current pollution. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** carrying capacity of the river** has been decreased by the dumping of **organic waste, sludge, and trash.**
 
• The** river is displaying signs of a complete loss** of aquatic biodiversity, and the water, which contains a mixture of sewage and industrial waste, is** dangerous to marine life.**
 
• 
 
The** Mithi river is still a concern after years of desilting and cleaning efforts. **The construction of tunnels to stop the flow of raw sewage and wastewater into the** Mithi river in early 2021 **was approved by the **BMC's standing committee. **
